---
title: IntAct
description: IntAct's molecular interaction evidence in PSI-MI MITAB 2.7, landed whole and stacked into annotation.interaction beside BioGRID.
---

[IntAct](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/intact/) (EMBL-EBI, with the IMEx curators)
publishes dated releases of curated molecular interactions. The release lands
`psimitab/intact.zip` whole: `intact.txt` and `intact_negative.txt`
(interactions shown *not* to occur), all 42 MITAB columns as text, every
organism and molecule type, the latest release only. The derived rows stack
into `annotation.interaction` under `source = 'INTACT'`. The directory date is
the version.

## Licence and citation

CC BY 4.0: "IntAct (EMBL-EBI), CC BY 4.0; del Toro et al. NAR 2022". Cite
the release date as `provenance.release` records it.

## Join keys

- The key is the interaction AC (`intact:EBI-…`) plus the pair as published: a MITAB row is binary, and most rows are the spoke expansion of an n-ary interaction under one AC.
- Interactors stay in IntAct's identifier space, split into namespace and id: UniProtKB accessions (95%, isoform suffixes kept), IntAct's own `EBI-` ids, ChEBI, Ensembl, RNAcentral. Nothing is mapped to genes; map UniProt accessions through `annotation.identifier_mapping` (human only so far).
- Single-participant interactions repeat A as B, the form BioGRID uses for self-interaction.

## Good to know

- The confidence score (`intact-miscore`) is recomputed every release and stays in raw.
- Negative interactions are told apart by MITAB's own `negative` column.
